zh-CN.name: 保存操作反馈
aliases: 点击后不知道成功没有
zh-CN.description: 把保存过程中的进行中、成功和失败结果告诉用户。
use_when: 保存需要等待，用户可能重复点击或无法判断结果
avoid_when: 把尚未完成的保存请求提前显示为成功
zh-CN.prompt_template: 对比无反馈与明确反馈两种保存流程。点击后经过 {feedback_delay_ms}ms 显示保存中，收到真实结果后再显示成功或可重试的失败状态，避免重复提交。此示例中的延迟为设计参数。

en.name: Save operation feedback
en.description: Communicate pending, successful, and failed save states.
use_when: A save request takes time and users may submit repeatedly
avoid_when: Displaying success before the request has actually completed
en.prompt_template: Compare save flows with and without explicit feedback. Show a pending state {feedback_delay_ms}ms after activation. Display success or a retryable error only after receiving the actual result, and prevent duplicate submissions. The delay is a design parameter for this example.

sources.note: 本维护包原创的操作状态案例，未声称引用某项 UX 研究或量化结论。
